title: Teal Mage Pose Trio
description: Three distinct full-body poses of the same female character with teal hair and glowing cyan magic effects, displayed side by side against a neutral gray background. The left shows a low crouching stance with magic circles, the center depicts a dynamic mid-air jump with swirling energy rings, and the right shows a wide combat stance with magical splashes at her feet.
prompt: A female character with short teal hair, pale skin with facial markings, wearing a dark purple cropped top, teal pants with star patterns, fingerless gloves, and a flowing black cape with teal inner lining. She is shown in three different dynamic action poses: crouching low with magic circles, leaping mid-air with swirling cyan energy rings around her hands, and a wide combat stance with glowing magic at her feet. Digital painting style, clean studio lighting, neutral gray background, vibrant teal and cyan magic effects.
